answer.says: Shri Hegde, your silence is heavier than the file. We are both ghosts haunting a bungalow that belongs to neither of us.
answer.thought: Hegde sits in the corner, a man who knows he is a ghost in his own allotment. The file is in the bureaucratic ether, a suspension that mirrors the stagnant air outside. My body is hollow, having walked fifteen kilometres on nothing but chai and pride, but the night is young and the air is cool at twenty-two degrees.
